entities.summary: DeAndre Rashaun Hopkins, nicknamed "DHop" and "Nuk", is an American professional football wide receiver who is currently a free agent. He played college football for the Clemson Tigers and was selected by the Houston Texans in the first round of the 2013 NFL draft. He has also played in the NFL for the Arizona Cardinals, Tennessee Titans, and Kansas City Chiefs. Hopkins is a five-time Pro Bowler and has been named to five All-Pro teams.
